bucketScopingRequirement: Every generated storage.objects policy must restrict the exact approved bucket_id before applying the owner predicate.

signedUrlModel: Server checks authenticated user.id and canonical object path before issuing signed upload/download URLs; Storage policies remain defense in depth and must cover the same bucket/path/operation relation.
